verdict.rationale: Martin ships several automation features that react to events without user re-invocation — email triage (auto-labels emails and takes follow-up actions), cc-to-schedule (triggered by being cc'd on an email), wake-up calls and briefings (time-triggered), and 'custom shortcuts that trigger multi-step actions' — which together approximate rule-based, event-triggered automation. However, none of the docs describe a general user-facing rule/condition builder (e.g., 'if email from X, then do Y') beyond these fixed built-in triggers, so it's more a set of preset automations than an open-ended rules engine. Missing for 10: a documented customizable trigger/condition system beyond named built-in behaviors, and independent hands-on evidence confirming reliability of these automatic triggers.
